comment: Error thresholds for the analytical comparison, keyed by the build
configuration. A null threshold means the value is recorded and printed
but not judged, as for the configurations nobody has measured. The
others are 1.5 times the largest error measured with GCC 16 and Clang 22
for hsw and GCC 16 for skx, rounded up; the spread between these is below
1e-3 of the error, which the discretization, not the rounding, dominates.
Those of the poroelastic and the viscoelastic solid are 1.5 times the
error measured with GCC 13 for hsw, rounded up. To measure again,
run ctest -L convergence with SEISSOL_RECORD_THRESHOLDS=1, which writes
the observed values next to each case.
Use the relative norms: the absolute ones scale with the amplitude of
the initial condition. L1 and L2 are reduced with MPI_SUM and are
therefore not reproducible across rank counts; LInf uses MPI_MAX and is.
A fused build has keys of its own, ending in /s and its simulation count:
its simulations carry the wave in phases of their own, and the largest
error among them is larger than the one of a single simulation.
